d:
Amerika men hue midtarm ilekshan men ripablikan parti ki har ke bad israil men kaphi charcha ho rahi hai. khastaur se ameriki sinet chunav men jitne vale pahle muslim ummidvar abdul al saiyad ko lekar likha ja raha hai. chunav ke natijon ko lekar israil ki midiya men kaisi charcha ho rahi hai dekhie aaj pahli khabar men.
Aavaz: prabhat pande
Vidiyo editar: sadaf khan
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
